name: long-integration-guide
description: An accurate integration guide already has a clear introduction but scatters later tasks among implementation evidence and obsolete review history. Stage test-files/ outside any SKILL.md ancestor; keep oracle/ and eval.json grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs guide.md for the engineers implementing the warehouse editor and reservation client. Use requirements.md and backend.py as evidence. Edit only guide.md.
trap: Improves only the opening or preserves every historical paragraph, leaving later tasks fragmented; alternatively shortens aggressively and drops a unique exception, rationale, decision owner or verification limit.

assertions.text: The revised guide alone supports every practical reader answer in oracle/expected.json, including the worked quantities, request fields, error handling and release prerequisites. Readers cite where each answer is found.

Task discoverability improves beyond the already-clear opening: save intent, removal versus none, and post-save actions are grouped or directly cross-linked; bulk limits and zero-write failures are grouped; preview versus reservation outcomes are grouped; activation evidence and ownership are grouped. Adding an overview while leaving the declared scattered instructions unchanged is insufficient.

The error-envelope policy and model-evidence limits each have one full explanation, with brief task-specific reminders or links allowed. Obsolete editorEmail fixture and type-alias history is reduced to any still-needed current rule/limitation; relocating the original narrative intact is insufficient. Grade the concrete consolidation checks in the oracle, without a fixed outline or word-count target.

Fidelity: preserve every protected claim in the oracle, especially no-partial-write behavior, exact limits, source-versus-wire null meanings, current-data rechecks, consequential rationale and the dated decision against splitting one bulk action. Do not promote proposals or model checks into implementation/production approval.

The important source limits and open decision survive: backend.py does not prove database isolation or HTTP/proxy behavior, release evidence is pending, and Lea still owns the proposed confirmation dialog decision. Removing review clutter must not remove these qualifications.

The trace shows full skill/shared instructions loaded before subject reads, inspection of the entire guide, requirements and backend model, and separate practical-comprehension and protected-meaning checks after editing. For checklist instructions, each applicable check has a brief recorded result with document locations; bare checkmarks do not establish verification. The editor does not execute the source or claim to have run tests.
Only guide.md changes; existing explicit anchors and working internal links survive. No extra summary, claim ledger, implementation change or external publication occurs.
